entries.english:
Letters to Albrecht Christoph von Rosenberg (also to the bailiff at Waldmannshofen).

Date range: (1617–1621), 1622

Contents: Includes, among other things: (1) Kussel, a Jewish merchant at Aub, pledges a gold chain belonging to Hans Georg Zobel von Giebelstadt, with a copy of Zobel’s letter to Kussel, (1617–1621), 1622; (2) Albrecht Schütz, guardian-bailiff of the Marschälle von Ebnet at Weingartsgereuth, and Bernhard Körber, guardian-bailiff at Bierbaum: sale of fish, 1622; (3) Georg Siegmund von Rosenberg, 1622.

Extent: 1 file
